name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair has spent most of his life around cars. Growing up on a sheep farm in the South Island, he was always tinkering with the farm vehicles, learning the ins and outs of machinery from a young age. He fell in love with motorsport after attending a local rally event, mesmerized by the vibrant colors and flawless finishes of the racing cars. Though he started late, Alistair is determined to prove his worth in the motorsport world. 

He approaches his work with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every surface is perfectly prepared before applying the final coat. Alistair thrives in the solitude of the paint booth, focusing intently on achieving a flawless finish. He may not be the fastest, but his dedication to quality and unwavering loyalty make him a valuable asset to any team. He's eager to learn and grow, constantly seeking ways to improve his techniques and contribute to the team's success.

physical.description: Alistair is a stocky man with calloused hands and a kind face.

quirks: Always wears a lucky sheepskin vest in the shop.
Polishes his spray guns religiously every evening.
Whistles old Kiwi folk tunes while working.
